instruction_text:
calm, steady news narration with natural emphasis at key points and turns; not dramatic.
Speak at a slightly slower, relaxed pace than natural adult narration, while keeping the delivery smooth, conversational, and natural. Do not exaggerate pauses or sound instructional.
asr_text: Some people may speak or feel differently if they think they are talking to AI. Knowing they are talking to a person may change that. Even if the request goes well, we cannot ignore the messy notice. We cannot just say it all worked out in the end. That was exactly what Meta admitted it had got wrong. Convenience matters, but some people care just as much about knowing who they are talking to. If AI passes the baton to a person, it should say so. That one line is part of the service, too. The person taking over does not have to be a secret guest.
